```{r, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
my_wd_all_dat <- "project_dir"

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(my_wd_all_dat))
```

```{r start time, include=FALSE}
start_time <- Sys.time()
```

## Add bldg variables
We add building information to parcels. Some of the additional information is available for the original buildings. Therefore, link via spatial query.

## Input data
- Pre-processed parcel data set of 2023
- Pre-processed building data set of 2021 and 2023
- Basic building datasets of 2021 and 2023
- Building age for buildings 2021, 2023

```{r, include=FALSE}
parcels_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_predictors_03_2023.gpkg")

bldg_23 <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/bldg_2023_05_cleaned_2023_par_id_bldg_type.gpkg")

# Additional building information 2023 must be further processed using the base dataset
bldg_23_base_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output/bldg_2023_01_base.gpkg")
bldg_age_23_raw <- st_read("./data_input/Baualter_letzte_Bautaetigkeit/Baujahr_Gebaeude_23.gpkg", layer = "GEBAEUDE_AKT_202312_Baujahr") %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

# Additional building information 2021 must be further processed using the base dataset
bldg_21_base_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/bldg_2021_01_base.gpkg")
bldg_age_21_raw <- st_read("./data_input/Baualter_letzte_Bautaetigkeit/Baujahr_Gebaeude_23.gpkg", layer = "GEBAEUDE_AKT_202012_Baujahr") %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
```

## Data processing

### Linking additional information of buildings to basic building layer
- We exclude buildings 2023 which are labled as NUUTZUNGSAR == 3001 (vollzogener Abbruch) from the dataset 2023 in order to get the building age of 2021 instead which is most of the time correct (see issue #23).
- bldg_age_23_raw: For the building age we use the variable G31_Max_Close which is the age of the nearest building to the point with the age information, if no point directly intersects the building. This can lead to errors in single cases, but generally reduces the number of NA values. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
## combine age and flats
bldg_23_add_info <- bldg_23_base_raw %>% 
  filter(use_code_bldg != 3101) %>% 
  transmute(id_bldg) %>% 
  left_join(bldg_age_23_raw %>% 
              transmute(id_bldg = GEBID, bldg_age = g31_34_Max_Close))

bldg_21_add_info <- bldg_21_base_raw %>% 
  transmute(id_bldg) %>% 
  left_join(bldg_age_21_raw %>% transmute(id_bldg = GEBID, bldg_age = g31_Max_Close)) 
```


### Prepare data for spatial intersection
```{r, include=FALSE}
# Set CRS of `bldg_23` as reference
reference_crs <- st_crs(bldg_23)

# Transform CRS of `parcels` to the CRS of `bldg_23`
parcels <- st_transform(parcels_raw, reference_crs)
bldg_23_add_info <- st_transform(bldg_23_add_info, reference_crs)
bldg_21_add_info <- st_transform(bldg_21_add_info, reference_crs)

# Rename and prepare variables
parcels <- parcels %>% transmute(id_par_merge)

# Calculate Point on Surface for polygons in bldg_23_base
bldg_23$label_point <- st_point_on_surface(bldg_23)
bldg_23_add_info$label_point <- st_point_on_surface(bldg_23_add_info)
bldg_21_add_info$label_point <- st_point_on_surface(bldg_21_add_info)
```

### Add parcel id to bldg_23_add_info
We add the id_par_merge also to the additional info, as we combine the data on the parcel level. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Check if the point on surface lies within the polygons in parcels
intersects_parcels <- st_intersects(bldg_23_add_info$label_point, parcels)

# Add the ID from parcels to bldg_add_info_base if the point on surface lies within the polygon
bldg_23_add_info$id_par_merge <- sapply(intersects_parcels, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(parcels$id_par_merge[x[1]])  # Take the ID of the first matching polygon (if multiple match)
  } else {
    return("F")  # If no match is found, insert service quality F
  }
})
```

### Add parcel id to bldg_21_add_info
We add the id_par_merge also to the additional info, as we combine the data on the parcel level. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Check if the point on surface lies within the polygons in parcels
intersects_parcels <- st_intersects(bldg_21_add_info$label_point, parcels)

# Add the ID from parcels to bldg_add_info_base if the point on surface lies within the polygon
bldg_21_add_info$id_par_merge <- sapply(intersects_parcels, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(parcels$id_par_merge[x[1]]) # Take the ID of the first matching polygon (if multiple match)
  } else {
    return("F")  # If no match is found, insert service quality F
  }
})
```

### Aggregate information on the parcel level
- For building footprint size and number of floors we derive the median per parcel. 
- For building age we calculate mean and median. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
bldg_23_var <- bldg_23 %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(id_par_merge) %>% 
  summarise(n_bldg = n(),
            area_foot_bldg_median = median(area_foot_bldg, na.rm = TRUE), 
            floors_bldg_median = median(floors_bldg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(n_bldg = if_else(is.na(area_foot_bldg_median), 0, n_bldg))

bldg_23_add_info_var <- bldg_23_add_info %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(id_par_merge) %>% 
  summarise(bldg_age_mean = mean(bldg_age, na.rm = TRUE), 
           bldg_age_median = median(bldg_age, na.rm = TRUE)) 

bldg_21_add_info_var <- bldg_21_add_info %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(id_par_merge) %>% 
  summarise(bldg_age_mean = mean(bldg_age, na.rm = TRUE), 
           bldg_age_median = median(bldg_age, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### Join information back to parcels
We join the datasets of 2021 and 2023. If there is a value for the parcel in 2023, we take this one. If there is not, we take the value for 2021. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Add column "Year"
bldg_21_add_info_var$Jahr <- 2021
bldg_23_add_info_var$Jahr <- 2023

# Combine both tables
bldg_add_info_var <- rbind(bldg_21_add_info_var, bldg_23_add_info_var)

bldg_add_info_var <- bldg_add_info_var %>%
  arrange(id_par_merge, desc(Jahr)) %>%  # Prioritize 2023 and keep only one row per id_par_merge
  group_by(id_par_merge) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

parcels_fin <- parcels_raw %>% 
  left_join(bldg_23_var) %>% 
  left_join(bldg_add_info_var) 
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
parcels_fin <- parcels_fin %>%
  mutate(n_bldg = if_else(is.na(n_bldg), 0, n_bldg), 
         persons_per_fa = persons_total_par/fa_23, 
         bldg_age_mean = if_else(bldg_age_mean < 1850, 1850, bldg_age_mean),
         bldg_age_median = if_else(bldg_age_median < 1850, 1850, bldg_age_median))
```

## Output
```{r, include=FALSE}
st_write(parcels_fin, "./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_predictors_04_2023.gpkg", delete_layer = TRUE)
```

```{r end-time, echo=FALSE}
message("Knitting completed in ", round(duration, 2), " ", attr(duration, "units"))
```
